title: OasisFx rig preset v1
description: Data-only description of a 2D cutout character (Skeleton2D bones, parts, two-bone IK, skins, poses) that OasisFx turns into a Godot 4 scene. Generated from addons/oasis_fx/src/core/rig_spec.gd; the GDScript validator is authoritative and also enforces the cross-field rules in docs/rig_format.md (bone hierarchy, references, IK chains).

asset_type.description: Asset kind: "rig" for a 2D cutout character (Skeleton2D, bones, parts, IK, skins, poses).

id.description: Stable identifier; also the output file name (<id>.tscn) and the root node name. Lowercase snake_case.

author.description: Who made the preset (person or AI tool).

source_license.description: License of the part images, e.g. "CC0", "own work".

bones.description: Bones, 1 to 64; a bone's parent must come before it. Bones without parent hang from the skeleton.

parts.description: Visible pieces, up to 128, each attached to a bone (it moves rigidly with it) or to the rig root.

markers.description: Named points attached to bones, up to 32 (a weapon tip, a hand): where animation events show effects.

ik_chains.description: Two-bone IK chains, up to 16: the two bones bend so the chain's tip reaches a target marker (arms reaching, feet staying on the ground).

skins.description: Costume variants, up to 32: each changes the image, color or visibility of some parts.

poses.description: Named poses, up to 64: bone rotations (and positions) applied with set_pose().

id.description: Bone identifier, unique among bones, parts and markers; becomes the Bone2D node name.

parent.description: Id of the parent bone; "" = attached to the skeleton (a root bone).

position.description: Rest position relative to the parent bone (or the rig root) in pixels [x, y]; +y is down.

rotation_degrees.description: Rest rotation relative to the parent in degrees, positive = clockwise.

length.description: Bone length in pixels (used by IK and the bone display).

angle_degrees.description: Direction the bone points in its own space: 90 = down (+y), 0 = right, -90 = up.

id.description: Part identifier, unique among bones, parts and markers; becomes the node name.

bone.description: Bone the part is attached to; "" = the rig root (does not move with bones).

kind.description: polygon = a filled outline (optionally textured); sprite = an image (layered PNG body part).

texture.description: Image of a sprite part (required for sprites), or the fill texture of a polygon part; "" = none.

polygon.description: Outline of a polygon part, 3 to 256 points [[x, y], …] in the bone's space (required for polygons).

position.description: Position relative to the bone (or the rig root) in pixels [x, y].

rotation_degrees.description: Rotation relative to the bone in degrees.

offset.description: Shifts the image/outline relative to the part's position, so the pivot (the joint) is where it should be.

color.description: Polygon fill color, or tint of a sprite (white = unchanged).

z_index.description: Draw order among parts; higher is in front (independent of the bone hierarchy).

visible.description: false = hidden unless a skin shows it.

uv.description: Texture coordinates of a textured polygon part in pixels of its image, one [x, y] per polygon point; [] = the points themselves (plus offset).

internal_vertex_count.description: How many of the last polygon points lie inside the outline (extra points for smoother bending); they are drawn only through polygons.

polygons.description: Custom pieces of a polygon part: lists of point indices (3 or more each), e.g. triangles that use the internal points; [] = fill the outline.

weights.description: Bone weights that bend (deform) a polygon part with up to 8 bones; [] = rigid. A weighted part is attached to the rig root (bone "").

values.description: One weight 0 … 1 per polygon point, in polygon order; a point's weights are divided by their sum, so it follows its bones in proportion.

id.description: Marker identifier, unique among bones, parts and markers; becomes a Marker2D node.

bone.description: Bone the marker moves with; "" = the rig root.

position.description: Position relative to the bone (or the rig root) in pixels [x, y].

id.description: Chain identifier; its target is the Marker2D IKTargets/<id> (animate its position to move the chain).

upper.description: First bone of the chain (e.g. the thigh or upper arm).

lower.description: Second bone, a direct child of upper (e.g. the shin or forearm); its tip reaches the target.

target.description: Starting target position relative to the rig root [x, y]; [] = where the chain's tip is in the rest pose.

flip_bend.description: Bend the middle joint the other way (knees forward vs. backward).

name.description: Skin name used with apply_skin("name"); the rig starts with the parts as defined (skin "").

parts.description: Changes of this skin, one entry per changed part.

part.description: Id of the part to change.

texture.description: Replacement image; "" = keep the part's image.

color.description: Replacement color/tint; "" = keep the part's color.

visible.description: Show or hide the part in this skin, or leave it as it is.

name.description: Pose name used with set_pose("name"); becomes the animation pose_<name>.

bones.description: Bones this pose moves; other bones keep their rest pose.

rotation_degrees.description: Rotation of the bone in this pose, relative to its parent, in degrees.

position.description: Position of the bone in this pose; [] = its rest position.
